fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The University of Toronto has campuses in Toronto, Mississauga and Scarborough. This page uses its **Master of Science in Applied Computing (MScAC)** with the Computer Science concentration to show real costs and entry rules.

The most important fact is the fee. For the programme starting in September 2026, U of T estimates **CAD 90,050** (**₹58.78 lakh**) for the whole 16 months, for international students.

| | MScAC (Computer Science) |
|---|---|
| Campus | Toronto |
| Length | 16 months full time |
| Internship | Eight months, paid |
| Intake | Fall only |
| Estimate for the whole programme | **CAD 90,050** (September 2026 start) |
| Minimum standing | **B+** (U of T 77 to 79%) |
| English test (IELTS), if needed | **7.0** overall, **6.5** in each part |
| Application deadline for Fall 2027 | **1 December 2026** |

U of T is a designated learning institution. IRCC's list shows it as a public institution. Its DLI number is O19332746152.

## What it really costs

The study permit asks you to show enough money for tuition, living costs and travel. Read the [proof of funds guide](/study-abroad/study-in/canada/canada-proof-of-funds-guide) for the rules.

U of T's estimate of **CAD 90,050** covers the whole 16 months and includes a **CAD 2,200** pre-program fee. The Fall 2027 fee was not posted when we checked. IRCC also asks for **CAD 23,448** for living costs (**₹15.30 lakh**) and your flights. U of T does not split the programme by year, so ask it for your first-year amount. Toronto rents are in our [cost of living guide](/study-abroad/study-in/canada/canada-cost-of-living).

Rupee amounts use **₹65.27 per Canadian dollar**, the Bank of Canada rate for 27 November 2026. Rates move every day and your bank will charge its own rate, so treat the rupee figures as a guide.

## Getting in

U of T asks for a standing equal to at least **B+** in your final year. It asks for knowledge equal to three senior computer science courses, three letters of support and programme essay answers. See the [programme page](/study-abroad/program-detail/canada/university-of-toronto/toronto-mscac-computer-science) for the details.

## Deadlines

The deadline for Fall 2027 is **1 December 2026** at 11:59 p.m. Eastern time. The programme has one intake. U of T decides between December and April.

## Popular programs for Indian students

- [Master of Science in Applied Computing, Computer Science](/study-abroad/program-detail/canada/university-of-toronto/toronto-mscac-computer-science): 16 months, eight-month paid internship, estimate CAD 90,050.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if** you hold a strong computer science degree and want an internship inside the master's.

**Think carefully if** you hold a three-year degree, or if you need a fixed fee. U of T posts fees each July and they can change.

## Sources

- [MScAC apply page](https://mscac.utoronto.ca/apply/). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [MScAC programme home](https://mscac.utoronto.ca/). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [School of Graduate Studies: English language proficiency](https://www.sgs.utoronto.ca/future-students/admission-application-requirements/english-language-proficiency-testing/). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Ontario Graduate Scholarship at U of T](https://www.sgs.utoronto.ca/awards/ontario-graduate-scholarship/). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [U of T living costs in Toronto](https://www.studentlife.utoronto.ca/task/living-costs-in-toronto/). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [IRCC designated learning institutions list](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/prepare/designated-learning-institutions-list.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [IRCC proof of financial support](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/get-documents/financial-support.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Bank of Canada exchange rates](https://www.bankofcanada.ca/rates/exchange/daily-exchange-rates/). Checked on 28 November 2026.

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much does the U of T MScAC cost for international students?
faq_json.a: U of T estimates CAD 90,050 for the whole 16-month programme starting September 2026, about ₹58.78 lakh at ₹65.27 per Canadian dollar. That includes a CAD 2,200 pre-program fee. The 2027 fee was not posted.

faq_json.q: What marks do I need for the U of T MScAC?
faq_json.a: A standing equal to at least B+ (U of T 77 to 79%) in your final year of a four-year degree. Admission is competitive and the committee reviews your whole file.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for the MScAC for Fall 2027?
faq_json.a: 1 December 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern time. The programme has one intake, in the fall.

faq_json.q: Do I need IELTS for U of T MScAC?
faq_json.a: Only if your degree was earned where the language of instruction and examination was not English. If you need it, U of T asks for IELTS 7.0 overall with 6.5 in each part, or TOEFL 93.
